# ----------------
## Packages ##
# ----------------

```{r, message = FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(tidypaleo)

```

# ------- Baiau Superior --------

```{r, Pre-treatment}

# Initial long-format data frame (raw data):
ba_sup_raw_df <- read.csv("Select your directory/Unified_raw_dataframes/baiau_superior_raw_unified_data_frame.csv", sep = ";")

# Isotope dataframe:
ba_iso <- ba_sup_raw_df %>%
    distinct(sample, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
    select(sample, top.depth, mean.depth, bottom.depth, top.age, mean.age, bottom.age, age.interval, median.age, up.age.CI, low.age.CI, water.cont, density, perc.C, perc.N, d15N, d13C)

#'C/N' ratio:
ba_iso <- ba_iso %>% 
  group_by(sample) %>% 
  mutate('C/N' = perc.C/perc.N) %>% 
  ungroup()

ba_iso <- ba_iso %>% 
  mutate(
    "Carbon (%)" = perc.C,
    "Nitrogen (%)" = perc.N
  ) %>% 
  select(-perc.C, -perc.N)

# Into long format:
ba_iso_long <- ba_iso %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = d15N:"Nitrogen (%)", names_to = "param", values_to = "values") %>% #To create the columns "param" & "values".
  arrange(param)

```

# Tidyplot

```{r}

# Without ages:
ba.iso.plot <- ba_iso_long %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = values, y = mean.depth)) +
  geom_lineh() + 
  geom_point() +
  scale_y_reverse(
  breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 12)  #More breaks accross the y-axis.
) +
  facet_geochem_gridh(vars(param), scales = "free") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Depth (cm)", title = "Baiau Superior") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_blank(), #Remove panel background.
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), #Remove major gridlines.
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), #Remove minor gridlines.
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12)
  )

ba.iso.plot

# --------- Adding the age -----------

# Dataframes with the ages (generated with rbacon package for the subsampling resolution):
ba21_ages <- read.csv("Select your directory/Ages_tidypalo/ba_ages_tidypaleo.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ";")

# Baiau Superior's age model:
ba_age_depth <- age_depth_model(.data = ba21_ages, #Nombre de la dataframe con las profundidades y las edades
                         depth = ba21_ages$depth, #Nombre de la columna de profundidades
                         age = ba21_ages$mean, #Nombre de la columna de edades medias
                         age_min = ba21_ages$min, #Nombre de la columna de error mínimo
                         age_max = ba21_ages$max #Nombre de la columna de error máximo
                         )

ba.iso.plot.age <- ba.iso.plot + scale_y_depth_age(ba_age_depth, age_name   = "Age (cal yr BP)",

    # Primary y (depth):
    trans        = "reverse",                     # replaces scale_y_reverse()
    breaks       = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 12),      # major ticks every 10 cm

    # Secondary y (age) – optional:
    age_breaks   = seq(0, 7600, by = 1000)       # adjust to your range
  )

ba.iso.plot.age

```

# ------- Baiau Inferior --------

```{r, Pre-treatment}

# Initial long-format data frame (raw data):
ba_inf_raw_df <- read.csv("Select your directory/Unified_raw_dataframes/baiau_inferior_raw_unified_data_frame.csv", sep = ";")

#'C/N' ratio:
bain_iso <- bain_iso %>%

  ungroup()

bain_iso <- bain_iso %>%
```

```{r}
# Baiau Superior's age model:

    # Primary y (depth):

    # Secondary y (age) – optional:

bain.iso.plot.age
```
